tagline: Halfway between the bench and the press.

videos.title: Incline Bench Press: Gym Shorts (How To)

coaching.summary: Lie on a bench set to a moderate incline, lower the bar to your upper chest, then press it back up over your shoulders.
cues: Set the bench to a moderate incline, around 30 to 45 degrees.
Lower the bar to the upper chest, just below the collarbones.
Keep the shoulder blades back and press to lockout over the shoulders.
